at: A peasant sits in the packed earth
alt: A peasant in undyed white sits against a post; the song moves his mouth
scene: KOREAN WEBTOON movie still, dramatic manhwa COVER. NOT photoreal. Dusk Surabol lane. WIDE, figure small in the lower third. ONE device: a timber post as a hard vertical. A peasant in SIMPLE UNDYED WHITE hemp, bare feet, back to the post, mouth moving with a song, counting nothing. Faded red Goguryeo banner hanging in the lane. Pale paper sky, packed earth, giwa dissolving. #8B5A2B nowhere — this is the country’s white. No named faces. No crowd catalog. No text. No watermark.

at: The Harmony Council meets in a tent
alt: Half-ripped council tent; Nulji on a low stool; wind through the tear
scene: KOREAN WEBTOON movie still, dramatic manhwa COVER. NOT photoreal. Day, a half-ripped canvas tent in a Surabol yard. LOW THREE-QUARTER. ONE device: the tear as a hard diagonal of sky. LEFT of the sheet = Nulji, vermilion silk, Silla open gold crown, sitting on a LOW STOOL that is not a throne, overwhelmed, looking at the rip, no smile. A white sash tying the canvas. Two unnamed councillors as dark shapes only. #9a3060 as cool sun on red silk. Pale paper sky through the tear. No text. No watermark.

at: He takes his brother by the back of the neck

at: He takes Mihae the way he took Bohae

alt: Silhouette on a stake: arms spread, rope, a ring of Wa faces, fire waiting

A man-shaped silhouette tied, arms spread, rope. Flames starting at the hem. A ring of unnamed Wa heads as dark stamps only. Fire the one key. Magenta-plum #8B5A2B in the fire, not on a face. No readable features. No text. No watermark.

at: The flames go up. Not a hearth. A column

Embers as bokeh. The rest crushed black. #8B5A2B in the fire only. No features. No text. No watermark.

at: The well-woman puts the bucket down

at: Nulji comes out of the gate. Not a funeral walk
alt: Nulji walks the lane; the crown is on; people stand and shout the name full
scene: KOREAN WEBTOON movie still, dramatic manhwa COVER. NOT photoreal. Day Surabol lane. LOW THREE-QUARTER, Nulji walking mid-stride, FACE LARGE enough. ONE device: the lane as a receding road, a faded red banner smaller now. LEFT of the sheet = Nulji, vermilion silk, Silla open gold crown ON, chin up, not hiding, a tired mouth that has decided to be a king. Tiny white-hemp figures standing, one bowing. Pale paper sky. #9a3060 as hard sun on red silk. No army. No text. No watermark.
